messages:
jamie: Quick sync — need to lock the v2.4.0 bump and update CHANGELOG before cutoff at 18:00 PT. Can we get a green-sweep of staging CI (all lanes) by 16:30 so we have time to triage flakies?

sophia: On it. I'm running the full smoke + e2e sweep now. Will report failures as they come.

tariq: Heads-up: I have a branch with the version bump and changelog draft at feat/release/v2.4.0. I'll push a PR in ~10m and request reviews from @ethan and @rebecca.

ethan: Ping me when PR is up. I'll do a quick review and merge if CI is green.

ci-bot: CI build queued: staging/smoke #1023

sophia: staging/smoke returned 12m ago, 2 failing tests: tests::integration::model_loading and tests::infra::retry_backoff. Looks flaky — stack traces suggest timeout on CUDA init.

rebecca: For model_loading, I saw a similar flake yesterday; increasing the timeout in the test helped. We should not block the cutoff for one flaky infra test — can we mark it flaky and rerun the suite?

jamie: Agree — mark infra::retry_backoff as flaky-regression for this run and rerun full suite. If only infra flakes remain, we'll proceed with the bump and add a follow-up ticket to stabilize.

sophia: Rerun started: staging/full #778

ci-bot: staging/full #778 status: running

sophia: Update: staging/full #778 finished — 1 failure remaining (tests::integration::model_loading). Suspecting noisy GPU node.

tariq: @sophia can you requeue the failing test on a different node? I can also repro locally and try a quick fix.

sophia: Requeued single test on gpu-07

ci-bot: staging/full rerun (targeted) #779 — PASSED

ethan: Great. I reviewed the PR, small nit on changelog formatting but nothing blocking. Approving now.

tariq: PR merged to release/v2.4.0. @jamie tagging the release branch for cutover.

jamie: Thanks all. Notes:
- Version bump applied
- CHANGELOG updated with 3 notable items
- CI green-sweep completed by 16:12 PT
- Filing ticket RL-231 to track infra flaky test fixes

rebecca: I'll pre-stage the canary deploy for tomorrow AM. Adding canary checklist to the PR description.

sophia: Adding the CI artifacts and logs to the release notes link: https://internal.ci/redwood/staging/778/artifacts

jamie: If no objections, we'll cut the release at 18:00 PT. Otherwise call it out here.

ethan: All good from infra and runtime side. :thumbsup:

rebecca: No objections. :rocket:

jamie: Closing the loop — thanks everyone. I'll post a short announcement in #announcements when cutover starts.
